company.name: MindsDB
company.shortDescription: MindsDB is an open-source platform that enables developers to integrate machine learning into applications.
company.description:
MindsDB utilizes machine learning so its users can ask predictive questions of their data and receive accurate answers from it. Adam Carrigan and Jorge Torres founded the open source company with a mission to democratize machine learning.

MindsDB was a graduate of YCombinator's recent Winter 2020 batch and was recently recognized by Forbes as one of America's most promising AI companies.

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise AI analytics platform that lets business and technical teams query structured and unstructured data in natural language without moving it into a separate warehouse.
productsAndServices.name: MindsDB Enterprise

productsAndServices.description: An open-source, container-deployable AI data platform for connecting machine learning models and large language models to databases and other data sources through a unified query interface.
productsAndServices.name: MindsDB Open Source

productsAndServices.description: A natural-language analytics solution that combines data from multiple sources to provide real-time business answers, reports, and traceable analysis without traditional ETL workflows.
productsAndServices.name: AI Business Insights Solution

productsAndServices.description: A conversational analytics solution that queries live MySQL databases, translates natural-language questions into SQL, and returns traceable answers without data replication or ETL.
productsAndServices.name: AI Analytics for MySQL
